results.title: LEGION BASEBALL: Pearson tosses no-hitter as Sixers top Sheridan
results.description: CHEYENNE – Right-hander Braden Pearson threw a complete game no-hitter to help the Cheyenne Sixers beat the Sheridan Troopers 7-0 in the winner’s bracket final at the Wyoming American Legion Baseball Division I state tournament Sunday night in Gillette.

results.title: 'That’s His Biggest Rival': LeBron James Would Never Want His 5th Ring With Stephen Curry, Says Warriors Analyst
results.description: The Warriors watched one of the biggest free-agent pursuits of the summer slip away. While many fans envisioned LeBron James joining forces with Stephen Curry for one final title run, the 4x champ ultimately chose the Philadelphia 76ers instead.
